fact: The DGSN's bilan for 2021 states that police arrondissements numbered 448 nationally and that during the year the generalisation of the GESTARR arrondissement-management information system was extended to the regional police services of Dakhla and the préfectures of Laâyoune and Casablanca, with the préfecture de police of Oujda to follow as the last stage; work also began on integrating the Sûreté nationale's wanted-persons and identification databases into GESTARR.
title: Bilan 2021 des services de la DGSN, couronnement d'une vision et d'actions de moralisation publique
